name: Jira
description: Your Jira Cloud issues in lanes (Backlog, In progress, Mentioned, On hold, Done), unread marks, sorted by Jev triage, discussed with Claude. Read-only towards Jira. Provides the jira service (issue status, the issue view) to other plugins, such as bronos.gmail, and an inbox-feed of your issues for Inbox.
author: BronOS
